I'm trying to figure out why p3 wants Virginia even though they don't own other pinks—maybe it's just a blocking move, since the pink set is split between three players and nobody can complete it without trading. I'm also mapping out who holds the orange and light blue properties to see where other monopoly opportunities exist.

Also, Water Works plus $150 cash for Virginia feels low given Virginia's value as leverage, especially since p4 won't trade States away. I think I'll counter for more cash, maybe $200 plus Water Works, since Virginia mainly serves as a blocking piece for me anyway.
